prompt: Name a country that shares a land border with Germany.

answers.name: France
answers.fact: The Rhine marks much of it; Alsace has changed hands four times since 1870.

answers.name: Poland
answers.fact: The Oder–Neisse line, fixed at the end of the Second World War.

answers.name: Austria
answers.fact: Germany's longest border with any country.

answers.name: Netherlands
answers.fact: Kerkrade and Herzogenrath are one town split down a single street.

answers.name: Switzerland
answers.fact: The German town of Büsingen sits as an enclave entirely inside Swiss territory.

answers.name: Belgium
answers.fact: The old Vennbahn railway leaves five scraps of Germany stranded inside Belgium.

answers.name: Czech Republic
answers.fact: Runs along the Ore Mountains and the Bohemian Forest.

answers.name: Denmark
answers.fact: Germany's only border with a Nordic country, settled by plebiscite in 1920.

answers.name: Luxembourg
answers.fact: The shortest of the nine, traced by the Moselle, Sûre and Our rivers.
